checks.name: build_and_cli_contract
checks.result: Workspace compiled. Two focused CLI checks passed, covering preview without writes, explicit acceptance, list/scan/reindex, read-only cached fact inspection, init reuse, ignore entries and conflict/error exits. Three affected indexer checks also passed.

checks.name: authority_mapping
checks.result: Ambiguous automatic goal candidates required an explicit manifest. A conflicting replacement manifest returned SourceConflict and left the existing project.toml bytes intact. Reinitialization with the existing mapping caused no rewrite.

checks.name: scan_vs_projection
checks.result: After a ledger edit, source scan reported one pending source and retained its previous projected work status; source reindex then committed the new status. Repeated unchanged indexing did not advance revisions.

checks.name: actual_project_cli_use
checks.result: Reviewed and accepted the repository mapping through awr init. Created .awr/project.toml and an ignored runtime database; indexed seven actual source files. CLI list, scan and reindex all agreed at project revision 21 with zero pending changes; doctor reported integrity ok and zero foreign-key violations.

checks.name: git_runtime_exclusion
checks.result: git check-ignore verified actual state.db plus WAL/SHM patterns, artifacts and cache paths. Only the source configuration is included in delivery.

limitations: M1 source intake is in practical use on this repository. Work queries, session/checkpoint workflows, context generation, MCP integration, real-client business acceptance and release gates remain later work. Unannotated project rule scope/severity still remain explicitly unresolved.
